meta.name: smart-explore
meta.description: Token-optimized structural code search using tree-sitter AST parsing. Use instead of reading full files when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase efficiently.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AST解析快速搜索代码结构，替代逐文件阅读
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在不熟悉的代码库中快速找到函数或结构
copy.tagline_en: Search code structure quickly with AST parsing, replacing full file reads
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find functions or structures in unfamiliar codebases

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 改用 AST 结构化搜索来看代码：smart_search 跨目录找符号和文件，smart_outline 给出单个文件的结构骨架，smart_unfold 只展开指定的函数或类源码。
howto.when: 当你需要理解代码结构、定位函数或探索代码库时触发。技能激活期间接管默认探索行为，用 smart_search、smart_outline、smart_unfold 取代 Read、Grep、Glob。

say.note: 返回排序后的符号与文件折叠视图

say.text: 给 services/worker-service.ts 出一份结构大纲

say.note: 只返回这个符号的完整实现

howto.what_en: Claude uses AST-based structural search: smart_search finds symbols and files across a directory, smart_outline gives one file's skeleton, and smart_unfold returns only the source of a symbol you pick.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to understand code structure, find functions, or explore a codebase. While active, smart_search, smart_outline and smart_unfold replace Read, Grep and Glob.

say_en.note: Returns ranked symbols plus folded file views
Lists all functions, classes and methods

say_en.text: Unfold the shutdown method in that file
say_en.note: Returns the full source of that symbol
